title: Attachments are missing from emails sent through the Resend batch endpoint
symptoms: Emails from resend.batch.send arrive without their attachments
The same payload sent through resend.emails.send arrives with the attachment
Type error on attachments in batch items after upgrading to resend 6.9.3
cause: The batch endpoint does not support the attachments field, and older SDK types accepted it anyway, so the files were dropped without an error. resend-node 6.9.3 removed attachments and scheduledAt from the batch item type.
fix: Send any email that carries attachments through the single send endpoint, and use batch only for emails without them, at most 100 per call.
apply: for (const e of emails.filter(e => e.attachments?.length)) await resend.emails.send(e); await resend.batch.send(emails.filter(e => !e.attachments?.length).slice(0, 100));
affected: Resend POST /emails/batch as of 2026-10; resend-node below 6.9.3 accepts the field in its types
